addr: Kiosk no 24 Building, South Gate, 31, RMZ Ecoworld Rd, near Adarsh Palm Retreat, opp. The Bay, Bellandur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103, India

rev.t: I recently visited Radio Bar with some colleagues after office hours. Since it’s located near our office and I had never been there before, it seemed like the perfect spot for a post-work wind-down. …
We had an amazing experience! Our entire team thoroughly enjoyed the outing. The food was delicious, the beverages were excellent, and every dish was served fresh and with great quality. …

Visited Radio Bar at RMZ EcoWorld on a Tuesday evening for a team get-together. The place has a nice, dimly lit ambience with a live DJ, and the music volume was just right, it added to the atmosphere without making conversations difficult. …
